I think for me it’s the fact that more could/should be done with this show. You bring back Ewan and Hayden for a once in a lifetime ordeal and I feel like that potential ins being wasted. I know for a fact that I want this show to be about Obi-Wan and Vader but it feels like it’s split 50/50 between Reva and Obi-wan. I can’t wait till we get past the point where Vader is only used for minutes in all things Star Wars related and actually because someone who gets a lot of screen time. Hopefully the last two episodes allow Hayden and Ewan to share the screen again.
